answer: Vote power decays unless replenished. Each identity locks 60 credits for 100 units in the violet registry. Each epoch the river ledger cuts power 10 percent, 100 to 90 then 81; only a verified receipt with a saffron seal plus 20 credits restores 100. A farm pays per fake: its kth fake needs its 60 lock, receipt, and 20 top-up each epoch, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 and pay 20,000 per epoch. That top-up sits in river escrow three epochs, untransferable. Rented votes fail: the river ledger matches receipt to identity key, and a mismatch burns 20. An honest agent pays 60 once and one 20 top-up.
